end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi correctly described 14 as one ten and four ones.
Saanvi correctly described 17 and 18 using ten and ones.
They were unsure on later items and teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised building numbers with one bundle of ten and extra ones. Saanvi used the method correctly for 14, 17, and 18, including connecting the tens and ones to the number name. They were unsure on the final two items, and those were not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, use sticks or small objects to make one group of ten plus loose ones for numbers 11–20, then say and write each number.
